world_strategy: One large World Partition experience composed of strongly themed streamed regions plus temporary event shells. Region borders should feel geographic, while event shells may visually span multiple regions without keeping full boss bodies loaded everywhere.

event_shells.name: The Devouring Moon
event_shells.purpose: Five-stage Gravefeeding escalation projected over eligible regions.
event_shells.load_policy: Only current stage projection actors and local gameplay organs load near active participants.

event_shells.name: Orun — The Walking Continent
event_shells.purpose: Continent-class encounter represented by region objectives, terrain shells, horizon silhouettes, and interior phase spaces.
event_shells.load_policy: Never instantiate one continent-sized always-loaded boss actor; distribute state through regional controllers.

event_shells.name: Mouth Behind the Moon
event_shells.purpose: Sky-scale eldritch event with projected tendrils and local organs.
event_shells.load_policy: Sky shell is presentation; damageable gameplay bodies remain regional.

event_shells.name: The Last Necropolis
event_shells.purpose: Moving city-fortress event assembled from streamed district segments.
event_shells.load_policy: Activate only nearby district geometry and objective actors; distant city state uses HLOD/presentation shells.

profiling_gates: Launch Session traversal from every neighboring region pair
World Partition streaming behavior verified around borders and teleports
HLOD visual continuity inspected for each skyline landmark
Spatial Profiler samples recorded for dense combat, vehicles, bosses, and world events
Memory Snapshot reviewed for high-cost assets on locally launched PC session
actor/entity counts reviewed together with game update and render time
event cleanup proves temporary actors, entities, and VFX leave memory after deactivation
mobile/portable and console-oriented profiles tested before production status
